class.name: RailVehicleRadio
class.description: The channel and the volume are the cab radio's own settings ([code]iRadioChannel[/code] and [code]m_radiovolume[/code] of the original's TTrain, [code]Train.h:918[/code]); whether the radio is on, powered, and what a Radio-Stop does to the vehicle are the backend's to answer. It knows no server: what it sends it announces ([signal radio_stop_sent], [signal radio_call_sent]), and the vehicle's owner transmits it from the vehicle's radio in [RadioServer]; what that radio hears the owner hands down.

method.name: channel_decrease
method.description: The channel [param step] lower, within [member channel_min].

method.name: channel_increase
method.description: The channel [param step] higher, within [member channel_max].

method.name: channel_set
method.description: Tunes to [param channel], clamped to [member channel_min]-[member channel_max]; [signal channel_changed] when it is another.

method.name: get_channel
method.description: The channel the radio is tuned to.

method.name: get_enabled
method.description: Whether the radio is switched on ([code]Radio[/code]).

method.name: get_powered
method.description: Whether the radio is switched on and has the low voltage to work.

method.name: get_radio_stop_active
method.description: The Radio-Stop received and not yet acknowledged ([code]RadioStopFlag[/code]).

method.name: radio
method.description: The radio switched on or off.

method.name: radio_call
method.description: [code]radiocall1_sw:[/code]/[code]radiocall3_sw:[/code] pressed sends [param call] to whatever listens in range - on the press, from a powered radio on any channel but the one without calls ([code]TTrain::OnCommand_radiocall1send/3send[/code], [code]Train.cpp:8209-8236[/code]).

method.name: radio_stop
method.description: [code]radiostop_sw:[/code] pressed sends Radio-Stop to every vehicle in range - on the press, and only from a powered radio ([code]TTrain::OnCommand_radiostopsend[/code], [code]Train.cpp:8149[/code]).

members.member: The highest channel the radio tunes to.
The lowest channel the radio tunes to.

signal.name: channel_changed
signal.description: The radio was tuned to [param channel].

signal.name: radio_call_sent
signal.description: A call to be transmitted on the radio's channel - the vehicle's owner transmits it from the vehicle's radio in [RadioServer].

signal.name: radio_stop_sent
signal.description: Radio-Stop to be transmitted - pressed on a powered radio.

signal.name: radio_toggled
signal.description: The radio came on or went off - powered, not only switched on.

signal.name: transmission_received
signal.description: What the vehicle's radio heard, Radio-Stop aside - a message for the cab to play ([CabinRadio3D]).

constants.constant: On this channel the radio sends no calls (Train.cpp:8211, 8228).
